body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #9, company drawn at random (seed 20261206) from Information Technology / Healthcare names in the Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.4 (naive base rate 0.33) that: Viyash Scientific Q3 FY27 (quarter ended 31-Dec-2026) consolidated revenue from operations is >= Rs 1,050 cr. Our reasoning: Q2 FY27 987.94; Q3 FY26 was +1% q/q; BioForLife adds a first quarter (~Rs 25-35 cr [EST]) -> ~1,030-1,040 central estimate. Naive base: needs +6.3% q/q; q/q growth in the last 4 merged quarters +1.0/+7.2/+2.9/+4.4% -> 1 of 4 (Laplace 2/6 = 0.33). Resolution: YES if consolidated revenue from operations for the quarter ended 31-Dec-2026, first reported, is >= Rs 1,050 cr. Source: NSE integrated-filing XBRL (consolidated) / screener consolidated. Resolve by 2027-03-15; score with Brier vs the base rate.
